g.text: A WRITING SKILL FOR CODING AGENTS

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6a63

g.text: BEFORE
tidyjson isn't just another JSON formatter — it
leverages a streaming parser to handle files of up
to 2 GB. The key insight is this: it uses around 40
MB of memory regardless of input size.
It's worth noting that tidyjson may potentially be
slower than jq on very small files. Overall, this
seamless approach is robust and flexible.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #176346

g.text: AFTER
tidyjson formats JSON with a streaming parser. It
handles files of up to 2 GB and uses around 40 MB
of memory regardless of input size.
tidyjson may be slower than jq on very small files.
